label: Phenomenal consciousness
search: "phenomenal consciousness" OR qualia OR "hard problem of consciousness"

label: Access consciousness
search: "access consciousness" OR (overflow AND "phenomenal consciousness") OR (reportability AND consciousness)

label: Neural correlates
search: "neural correlates of consciousness" OR ("conscious perception" AND (EEG OR fMRI OR MEG))

label: States and levels
search: "disorders of consciousness" OR "minimally conscious state" OR (anesthesia AND "level of consciousness") OR (sleep AND "conscious experience")

label: Contents
search: (("visual masking" OR "binocular rivalry" OR "inattentional blindness" OR blindsight) AND (awareness OR conscious))

label: Self and metacognition
search: "body ownership" OR "bodily self-consciousness" OR (metacognition AND awareness AND perception)

label: Theories
search: ("theory of consciousness" OR "global workspace" OR "integrated information theory" OR "higher-order theory" OR "recurrent processing theory" OR "predictive processing") AND consciousness

label: Artificial consciousness
search: "artificial consciousness" OR "machine consciousness" OR (consciousness AND "large language models")

label: Altered states
search: (psychedelic OR psilocybin OR meditation OR hypnosis) AND ("altered states of consciousness" OR "conscious experience")

label: Animal consciousness
search: "animal consciousness" OR (sentience AND (fish OR insects OR invertebrates OR cephalopods))

label: Attitude senses of consciousness/awareness
search: "environmental consciousness" OR "brand awareness" OR "health consciousness" OR "class consciousness"

label: Loss of consciousness as a clinical endpoint
search: "loss of consciousness" AND (sedation OR propofol) AND (dose OR hemodynamic)
